plugins.name: spec-align
plugins.description: Single entry point for structured requirements → architecture alignment. Phase 1 grills the product owner to extract BDD scenarios; Phase 2 grills the SWE on architecture and records the result as an SDD.

plugins.name: learn-mentor
plugins.description: Learning mentor that drives true mastery instead of completing the task for you — stages a learning goal through gap-surfacing, guided paper reading, hands-on implementation, and teach-back, withholding exactly the skill the goal targets

plugins.name: commit-splitter
plugins.description: Scan all staged/unstaged changes, combine with session context and plan, generate an ordered conventional-commit plan within a token budget

plugins.name: diagnose
plugins.description: Diagnose bugs and issues by systematically gathering context and forming hypotheses

plugins.name: grill-with-docs
plugins.description: Interview the user about a codebase using its documentation as the primary source

plugins.name: triage
plugins.description: Triage a list of issues or tasks, prioritizing by impact and effort

plugins.name: improve-codebase-architecture
plugins.description: Analyze and suggest improvements to the codebase architecture

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Drive development using test-driven development practices

plugins.name: to-issues
plugins.description: Convert a plan or discussion into actionable GitHub issues

plugins.name: to-prd
plugins.description: Convert a discussion or plan into a product requirements document

plugins.name: zoom-out
plugins.description: Step back and review the bigger picture of what is being built

plugins.name: prototype
plugins.description: Rapidly prototype a solution to validate an idea

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Explain complex code or concepts in simple, plain language

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Prepare a clear handoff summary of current work and context

plugins.name: write-a-skill
plugins.description: Help the user write a new Claude Code skill

plugins.name: architecture-diagram
plugins.description: Generate beautiful dark-themed system architecture diagrams as standalone HTML/SVG files

plugins.name: checkpoint
plugins.description: Save and restore session context across token resets and machine switches

plugins.name: record-adr
plugins.description: Scan the current session context and the project's adr/ directory to create or update an Architecture Decision Record

plugins.name: init-project
plugins.description: Bootstrap Claude Code framework config for a new project: generates CLAUDE.md framework section and .claude/settings.json with standard harness

plugins.name: grill-graph
plugins.description: Heavyweight grilling that records the decision tree as a live graph — rejected branches, re-assumptions, back-references — then converges it into a spec

plugins.name: blog
plugins.description: Interactively distill a valuable session into a bilingual (zh + en) technical blog post and stage it as a draft in the lyeh-infra Hugo blog

plugins.name: stop-slop
plugins.description: Remove AI writing patterns from prose — cut filler, break formulaic structures, score on 5 dimensions. Use when drafting, editing, or reviewing text to eliminate predictable AI tells
